cases.control: a watched public item is listed inside Wishlist, under a Watching heading
the watched row is labelled Watching, says it is someone else's item, and keeps its source link
Add to my wants makes a want of your own with the source link and NO price copied from the other person's listing
watching or adding it to my wants did not create an owned Vault record
the watched item itself is kept after Add to my wants
adding the same watched item again does not make a copy
the default checklist lists items with edition and quantity, and shows no prices or private notes
switching prices on adds them and the planned total to the checklist
Share a read-only link turns sharing on and shows the link
a visitor with the link sees the wishlist titles
a visitor sees no private notes, prices or target prices
skipped wants are not shown on the shared link
the printable checklist shows prices and notes only when they were switched on
the checklist page is a print document (site bars do not print, text prints black on white)
turning sharing off stops the link
a want added while offline appears at once on this device
while offline it has not reached the account (so it is held for retry)
after reconnecting and reloading, the offline want is still there (not lost by the account read)
the retry sent it to the account once connected (one row, not two)
a want removed while offline disappears at once
after reconnecting, the removed want is not brought back by the account read
the delete reached the account on retry
acquiring while offline saves to the Vault on this device and says it will upload later
